description: The Anbani.ge project is a Georgian-language web application platform that aims to enrich and support the Internet space with all levels of our writing.
inspiration: Anbani.ge supports the initiative of Bumberazi linguist Akaki Shanidze to introduce the round capital letter as the main upper case letter of the Georgian script. Unfortunately, despite great efforts, this idea could not be implemented in Soviet Georgia, although it is never too late.
app-desc-emoji: Find the right emoji in Georgian or English
app-desc-converter: Convert Georgian text to Old Georgian or Georgian
app-desc-keyboard: All Georgian symbols on one virtual keyboard
app-desc-textart: The first Georgian text art generator
app-desc-embeddings: Georgian language model learned by artificial intelligence
app-desc-wordnet: More than just a self-taught high-tech thesaurus
